Before you begin

A little more clarity.

When can I download COR?

COR is coming soon for iPhone, with a companion Apple Watch app. This page shows features built into the current app. Download links will appear when access opens.

Do I need an account to see my plan?

No. You can answer the setup questions and review suggested targets and a goal timeline before signing in. Sign in when you want to keep and sync your plan.

What can I use without COR Pro?

The core app includes your plan and targets, food search, manual entries, recognized barcode lookup, calorie and macro tracking, workout logging, strength and weight progress, and supported Apple Health connections. COR Pro adds select AI-assisted features; the exact offer is shown in the app.

Are meal-photo calories exact?

No. Photo and text results are estimates. Before a photo analysis, you can add hidden ingredients, choose a portion and leave a note. Review and edit the result before saving it to your day.

Does COR work with Apple Health and Apple Watch?

With your permission, COR can connect supported Apple Health activity, sleep, body measurements and nutrition data. The companion Watch app can follow a workout, record sets and manage rest.

What happens when I use an AI feature?

COR asks for permission before sending content you choose to analyze, such as a meal photo, food description or menu image, to an external AI provider. Separate AI controls are available in the app. Manual logging does not require those AI analyses.
